definitions.explanation: A camera that develops and prints a photograph immediately after the picture is taken. In Japan, Fujifilm's Instax line is the dominant brand.

examples.japanese: インスタントカメラ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a photo with an instant camera.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧インスタントカメラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大活躍|だいかつやく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The instant camera saw a lot of use at the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧インスタントカメラ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: Lately instant cameras are popular among young people again.

notes:
Loanword. The classic Polaroid-style format that produces a printed photo within seconds. Saw a retro revival in Japan from the 2010s onward.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- インスタントカメラ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a photo with an instant camera
- インスタントカメラ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧: instant camera film
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧: disposable camera (a related but distinct product)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- チェキ: Cheki — Fujifilm Instax brand name, used as a generic word for instant cameras and prints
- ポラロイド: Polaroid — the original brand; sometimes used generically
